03 / MY EVALUATION APPROACH

Find the failure.
Make it reproducible.

TASK DESIGN
TESTING & REVIEW

I evaluate more than whether an answer looks convincing. I test what the software actually does, isolate failures, and check that a repair preserves the behavior that already worked.

SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MEETS AI EVALUATION
01

Design a meaningful challenge.

Clear requirements, interacting features, and edge cases that test real reasoning.

02

Test the behavior, not the story.

Reproduce the result. Check correctness, boundary inputs, persistent state, and regressions.

03

Turn findings into useful feedback.

Document the failure, validate the reference fix, and produce an evaluation another engineer can reproduce.
